messages.content: You are the single research Agent in a strict autoresearch loop for iMet 2020 FGVC7. Return JSON only. Propose one complete Python candidate with train(data_dir,artifact_dir,budget_seconds,seed) and predict(artifact_dir,paths). The Host passes relative image paths; candidate loads images lazily from /data/<path>. There are 3474 independent multilabel attributes. Use only fit.csv and fit_labels.npz for fitting; tune.csv/tune_labels.npz are calibration/model-selection only; search.csv/test.csv have no labels in the candidate view. The Host scores hidden search by micro-F1 on the 3474-column indicator matrix. Use one global threshold selected from 0.02..0.50 on tune only, record it, and use argmax fallback for empty rows. Do not flatten labels. Image-only lazy decoding; no full-corpus descriptor cache. Save a self-contained model and preprocessing under artifact_dir; predict must work in a fresh process and reload identically. No network, credentials, hidden labels, historical code/weights or other experiments. Generic torchvision pretrained weights are allowed only if declared in public_models and made available offline. Do real convergence-aware training, report architecture, selected parameters, seed, threshold and internal validation trajectory. Do not fabricate results.
